property_summary: On any successful play with the exact ticket price, the pot is drained (pot==0) exactly when the on-chain coin flip (keccak256(timestamp,difficulty,sender))%2==0 and stays at TICKET_AMOUNT otherwise; the mutant wins on the opposite flip, so it ends a successful play with pot==TICKET_AMOUNT when flip==0 (or pot==0 when flip==1), breaking the invariant for some input.
change_summary: Change the winning condition from 'random == 0' to 'random == 1' so wins occur on the opposite outcome.
